title: Smart Thermostat Installation and Setup
text:
We're committed to your complete satisfaction with our service. If you're not 100% happy, we'll do whatever it takes to make it right.

Frequently Asked Questions:
Q: How do I know if my smart thermostat is compatible with my heating/cooling system?
A: The manufacturer of your smart thermostat should provide detailed information on this. You'll need to power off your system and remove the cover from your current thermostat and inspect the wiring to determine compatibility.
Q: What is a C wire?
A: A C wire is a wire that's dedicated to delivering constant power to your thermostat. Most smart thermostats can charge their built-in battery using your system’s heating and cooling wires, but in a small number of situations you may need a C wire for consistent power to your thermostat. HelloTech does not provide HVAC services, so you'll need to consult with an HVAC specialist.
Q: What else should I be aware of?
A: The most important thing to know is that most smart thermostats are not compatible with high voltage systems. Common indications of high voltage systems include terminals listed as L1 or L2, a warning label or a label reading 110V/120V/240V on the back plate of your existing thermostat. Smart thermostat installation is only possible where there is an existing thermostat and adequate WiFi is necessary at the install location.
Q: What if I have multiple thermostats in my home?
A: If you have multiple thermostats in your home, a smart thermostat can replace any or all of them. You don't need to replace all of your current thermostats. Existing thermostats will continue controlling your system just like they always have. We recommend installing the smart thermostat in your primary living area.

title: Video Doorbell Installation
text:
We're committed to your complete satisfaction with our service. If you're not 100% happy, we'll do whatever it takes to make it right.

Frequently Asked Questions:
Q: Where can I install a video doorbell?
A: Battery-powered video doorbells can be placed virtually anywhere you have adequate WiFi. For hard-wired models, you'll need to install it where there is an existing, functioning doorbell delivering sufficient power. If there isn't enough power, your tech can provide and install a new transformer at an additional cost. If you don't have power at the desired install location, you'll need to contact an electrician.
Q: What else should I be aware of?
A: We recommend installing the doorbell in a location that provides a clear view of your entryway. Some manufacturers offer accessory plates that adjust the angle of your doorbell providing an improved view.
Q: Are there any other requirements?
A: Most video doorbells require a functioning chime inside your home. If you don't have an existing chime or if it's not compatible, some manufacturers offer a chime accessory device.

•	Transferring data to an external hard drive

title: Computer Repair & Help
text:
We're committed to your complete satisfaction with our service. If you're not 100% happy, we'll do whatever it takes to make it right.

Frequently Asked Questions:
Q: What do I do if I'm not really sure what the problem is?
A: That's why we're here! Some customers prefer to book a HelloTech Now! service. A tech will assess your computer remotely to either resolve the issue or to diagnose the problem. If your issue requires an in-home visit, we can schedule a follow-up service. HelloTech Now! is a great value, immediate and available 24x7.
Q: Can HelloTech replace my hard drive?
A: No, HelloTech cannot replace your hard drive because we do not repair hardware. If your problem requires hard drive replacement, we can only diagnose the issue, not repair it.
Q: My computer is very old. Can HelloTech help?
A: HelloTech can try to help, but sometimes repairing older computers is more costly than replacing the computer altogether. If your computer is more than 4-5 years old, consider your options. And if you need help setting up your new computer, HelloTech is here to assist.
Q: Can HelloTech help to add memory to my computer?
A: No, HelloTech does not add memory to your computer. Adding memory requires access to the inside of your computer, and HelloTech does not provide hardware support. If the problem you have requires additional memory, we can only diagnose the issue.
Q: What is included in the Computer Repair & Help service from HelloTech?
A: HelloTech offers a comprehensive Computer Repair & Help service for our customers, and it includes the following:
•	Diagnosis and troubleshooting of a single issue
•	Instant support through HelloTech NOW depending on the nature of your request
Q: How much does HelloTech's Computer Repair & Help service cost?
A: HelloTech's Computer Repair & Help service begins at $79 for remote service, $99 for in-home service, and $0 for HelloTech Home members.
Additional charges related to problems your computer may be having are for covering the cost of troubleshooting.
•	If your computer starts, but crashes or freezes right away, this is an additional $30.
•	If your computer is making loud noises, this is an additional $30.

A: A tune-up is appropriate when your computer is properly functioning but seems a little sluggish. Many customers book regular tune-ups a few times a year - depending on your usage - to keep their computer in top-top shape. It's best to prevent problems rather than waiting until you have one to deal with.

•	Increasing the speed and performance of your computer
•	Performing system cleanup and defragmentation
•	Getting rid of any unnecessary programs
•	Cleaning up physical hardware
•	Virus removal (extra charges apply)
•	Instant online assistance with HelloTech NOW depending on the nature of your request
Q: How much does HelloTech's Computer Tune-up service cost?
A: The base price for HelloTech's Computer Tune-up service is $35 and is $0 for members of Smart Home Plus. If you would like in-home service instead of HelloTech NOW, the base price is $79.
Q: What happens if a technician finds a virus on my computer?
A: If a technician finds a virus on your computer and your Computer Tune-up service ends up requiring virus removal, you may have to pay extra charges, but you will be notified beforehand so it's not a surprise. The good news is that HelloTech can help you remove the virus with our Virus Removal service.

Q: How high should I mount my TV?
A: The ideal height for TV mounting depends mainly on four factors: the size of the TV, how far away you'll be, your eye level height, and the viewing angle. 
As a rule, the center of a 42” TV should be mounted about 56 inches from the floor, a 55” TV around 61 inches, a 65” TV around 65 inches, and a 70” TV around 67 inches. But the exact mounting height will vary depending on your eye level, which will vary depending on the height of your seats, couch, or bed.

Q: What makes HelloTech's Virus Removal service different from antivirus software?
A: HelloTech's Virus Removal service is different from antivirus software because it includes in-person assistance with computer virus removal.
Antivirus software is designed to prevent viruses from getting onto your computer in the first place, while HelloTech helps remove existing viruses from your system. HelloTech's Virus Removal service includes the installation of antivirus and antispyware software along with many other components.

•	Identifying the problem and troubleshooting for one affected computer
•	Performing a full system sweep for any viruses, spyware, or malware
•	Removal of any viruses, spyware, or malware
•	Repairing of any related issues with your Operating System
•	Installation of customer-supplied antivirus and antispyware software
Q: Will my tech install new antivirus software?
A: Yes! Your technician will help you install customer-supplied antivirus and antispyware software.
Q: What happens if a technician finds that my problem isn’t caused by a virus?
A: If a technician finds out your issue is unrelated to a virus, malware, or spyware on your computer, you may have to pay extra charges for additional services, but you will be notified beforehand so it's not a surprise.

A: We will not be able to replace any missing hardware that came with your items.

If assembly is required, be sure to book our furniture assembly service along in the same order.
